changes: Only three tool markers: VOICE SYNC - Video on the V1 nest, VOICE SYNC - Voice and VOICE SYNC - Caption on the voice file (#96, PR #97).
Auto edit builds V1-A1 and voice A2, creates captions, runs one post-check and writes markers once per source; the marker pre-write, journals and projection compare are removed (#94, PR #95).
Gan marker always removes every old tool marker; unplaceable warnings are listed as unattached; no ruler markers.
A caption failure still writes Video and Voice markers; only Caption markers are skipped and the panel names the caption error.
Stop or error keeps the timeline as far as the run got; markers are only written in the last step; a late Stop keeps the finished result; the original error comes first (#90, PR #91).
No compatibility with older versions: 2.20.x markers are not recognised, the EXE-installer migration and old settings, job and alignment formats are removed (#96, #98, PR #99).
A slowed picture piece capped by Premiere gets its Out restored before its end, for every piece, so no picture gap is left (#102, PR #113).
Equal-overlap ties attach the marker to the piece holding the warning midpoint, else the earlier piece (#103, PR #104).
Tao phu de explains in plain Vietnamese when recognised speech does not match the SRT (#105, PR #106).
Stop or an error never blocks later runs; Tao phu de restores mute, enable and In/Out automatically and only warns on failure (#107, PR #108).
Dung theo voice runs one input check that lists every refusal reason with guidance; an existing Caption Track is accepted (#109, PR #110).
Tao phu de reads its input once and drops the unused legacy path (#111, PR #112).
knownLimitations: The first build ran the native checklist on 2026-11-20: items 1-4 passed, items 5-7 found the issues fixed above. This rebuild still needs the affected items rechecked in Premiere.
Placing 19 markers on the V1 nest took 18.3 s in the 2026-11-20 run; a speed-up is planned for a later version.
Markers written by 2.20.x are not recognised: remove them by hand once or use a clean template, otherwise new markers avoid their frames and may shift or stay unattached.
Setup/Remove on a clean Windows account and an antivirus scan were not recorded for this build.
FFmpeg 8.1.2 source is not attached to the release; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md links to it (user decision 2026-11-15).
